limitations: Experimental_Design.xlsx is internally wrong in two places, both corrected from stronger evidence: (a) its MS-method column swaps RW8/RW9/RW10 (raw headers: RW8=CID, RW9=MSA, RW10=HCD); (b) for incorporation runs A1-A16 it lists A1-A8 as K8R10 and A9-A16 as K4R6, whereas the deposited incorporation search (summary.txt) labels A1-A8 Arg6;Lys4 and A9-A16 Arg10;Lys8, the calculation sheet calls A1-A8 "medium" (=K4R6), and median log2(H/L) of 3.7-5.9 for those labels shows they are really incorporated. Sample identities per run are still taken from the design sheet (pairing A1/A9, A2/A10 ... is consistent with the calc-sheet IDs 2.1-3.5).
Per-embryo identity (which KO/WT embryo is in which mixture/dish) rests on the design sheet alone; only the genotype orientation per channel is independently confirmed by the phosphosite ratios.
Control1-4: genotype, organism part, cell type, sex, developmental stage and strain are not stated anywhere; written as not available. Organism Mus musculus is inferred.
Multistage activation (MSA) has no PSI-MS dissociation term; MSA runs (RW9) are annotated as collision-induced dissociation with 35 NCE.
K4R6 is the lighter of two isotope-labelled media (no K0R0 arm); following the authors and MaxQuant it is written SILAC light, not SILAC medium.
Reduction (DTT) / alkylation (iodoacetamide) reagents are stated in Methods but not annotated (optional columns).
mqpar.xml references several runs with acquisition timestamps appended (e.g. DNU7717A17RW10_SU_A1_170208113643.raw); the deposited file names lack the suffix and are used as deposited.

QC runs: precursor mass tolerance is not stated in the deposited QC search output (parameters.txt/summary.txt list no peptide tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited for these searches); column omitted rather than assume a MaxQuant default. The Arg->Pro conversion re-search of A1-A16 (Pro5/Pro6 labels) is not represented.

Trypsin for the A1-A16 incorporation runs (raw headers "Digest of LB-n", single-label lysates) is INFERRED: the Methods digestion text describes the mixed samples, and the QC parameters.txt names no enzyme beyond the summary.txt protease Trypsin/P. Written as Trypsin + not applicable, i.e. the first (trypsin-only) digest step.

Control 1-4 organism part / cell type / material type are left not available, although the controls very likely come from the same SILAC cortical-neuron culture series (incorporation-checked as LB-1/LB-2 and LB-9/LB-10, culture IDs 2.1/2.2). Nothing states their biology, so the conservative value is kept.

comment[label]: K4R6 is written SILAC light here as in the approved phospho SDRF (authors, design sheet and main MaxQuant search call it light). The incorporation calculation sheet and its QC search experiments call it "medium" (no unlabelled arm exists); kept light so the same culture dishes carry the same label in both files of this dataset.

Raw file A13RW3 is named "DNU7717A13RW3_SU_E2-blank" in the incorporation search, but its header says "Digest of LB-13" and it yields 4853 evidence rows with normal incorporation; treated as the WT2 sample of the design sheet, not as a blank.
